## Install

It lands in `src/rost/accordion/`, with what it needs and its contract. In an app that uses shadcn:

```sh
npx shadcn add https://rost.build/r/accordion.json
```

Then import `src/rost/fonts.css` and `src/rost/tokens.css` once, at the root of the app. More on this in [Install](../INSTALL.md).

## Props

| Prop | Type | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | slot |  |  |

## Anatomy

- `root`: A `<div>` holding the items in a column.
- `item`: A Disclosure, as it is, with 12px above and below and a 1px line under it.

## When to use

- **Questions and answers.** A few questions where most people need one answer: what counts as a business expense, when tax is due.

## When not to use

- **Things everyone needs.** If most people open every item, show them open.
- **One thing to hide.** A single detail out of the way is one **Disclosure**.

## Behaviour

Each item opens on its own; opening one doesn't close the others. It's Disclosures in a column with lines between them.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: A `<div>` of `<details>`, so each summary is a button the browser knows opens.
- **Keyboard**: Tab moves between summaries; Enter or Space opens and closes.
- **Colour**: The lines are decoration.
